name: 7 Wonders
description: Draft cards over three ages to build a city and a wonder (2nd edition). Leaders, Cities and the Wonder Pack are options. Private local build: not for distribution.

leaders.title: Leaders
leaders.description: The Leaders expansion: a leader draft before Age I, a leader recruited at the start of each age, Roma, four guilds, and 6 starting coins instead of 3.

leaderPromos.title: Promo leaders
leaderPromos.description: Adds Louis, Stevie and Esteban to the leaders. Needs Leaders.

cities.title: Cities
cities.description: The Cities expansion: black cards (one per player per age), debt, diplomacy, three guilds, Petra and Byzantium. Needed for 8 players.

wonderPack.title: Wonder Pack
wonderPack.description: Four more wonder boards: the Great Wall, Stonehenge, Manneken Pis, and Abu Simbel (dealt only with Leaders).

sideB.title: Play the B side of every wonder
sideB.description: Otherwise every wonder is on its A side.

randomSides.title: Random wonder sides
randomSides.description: Each wonder's side is drawn at random (overrides the B side option).

teamPlay.title: Team play
teamPlay.description: 4, 6 or 8 players in adjacent pairs: teammates do not fight, conflict tokens are doubled. Seats stay individual in the result.
